name: capital-gains
rows: Please note that the Short term or Long-term capital Gain/Loss on stocks which are taken over by us as corpus or taken over as partial switch from other strategy is only indicative & has been calculated as per the takeover date and

rate as determined at the valuation as on the date of takeover. You are advised to recalculate the Short term or Long-term Gain/Loss on these taken over stocks based on the actual purchase price and original date of purchase of

these stocks by you. This report is generated considering FIFO movement of securities at client Id level except for certain specified transactions wherein original acquisition cost and date of transferred securities is considered. For

calculation of grand-fathered purchase price (as applicable) higher of highest traded price on BSE or NSE is considered. You are advised to use this report in consultation with your tax advisor. Buyback of shares - Gains are
Exempt from Tax as per prevailing Income Tax provisions and is subject to change. [Tax on Buyback of shares is no longer exempted in the hands of investors w.e.f 01st October 2024]
Capital Gain/Loss Summary (Based on Effective Gain / Indexation)

Please note that the Short term or Long-term capital Gain/Loss on stocks which are taken over by us as corpus or taken over as partial switch from other strategy is only indicative & has been calculated as per the takeover date and

rate as determined at the valuation as on the date of takeover. You are advised to recalculate the Short term or Long-term Gain/Loss on these taken over stocks based on the actual purchase price and original date of purchase of

these stocks by you. This report is generated considering FIFO movement of securities at client Id level except for certain specified transactions wherein original acquisition cost and date of transferred securities is considered. For

calculation of grand-fathered purchase price (as applicable) higher of highest traded price on BSE or NSE is considered. You are advised to use this report in consultation with your tax advisor. Buyback of shares - Gains are
Exempt from Tax as per prevailing Income Tax provisions and is subject to change. [Tax on Buyback of shares is no longer exempted in the hands of investors w.e.f 01st October 2024]
